posts.title: Cesium Chlorometallates Near the Perovskite Abyss
posts.description: Long-time readers and fellow inorganic chemistry appreciators probably already know about the halometallate ions and in particular, about a beloved long-time staple of hobbyist chemistry - the tetrachlorocuprate. The correct IUPAC-approved nomenclature for the ion is “tetrachloridocuprate” and it will be mentioned exactly once and then promptly forgotten and left in the annals of history even if it does convey slightly more information.
